description: This file defines the internal sealed class 'SystemTargetShared' within the Orleans.Runtime namespace. The class manages components related to runtime clients, scheduling, grain references, timers, and activation directories, providing methods to create work item groups and exposing various properties for runtime operation.

classes.name: SystemTargetShared
classes.description: A class that encapsulates shared runtime components and provides methods to manage work item groups in the Orleans system.

methods.name: CreateWorkItemGroup
methods.description: Creates and returns a new WorkItemGroup associated with the specified SystemTarget.
